next_audit_action: Complete CI verification for INKBUG-0001, then continue Presentations font/text scaling and save/reopen fidelity audit.

INKBUG-0001.title: PPTX normal AutoFit line-spacing reduction lost on text rewrite
INKBUG-0001.environment: InkDOS 2.0.12 source/package-preservation path; synthetic OOXML normAutofit fixture semantics
INKBUG-0001.reproduction: Open an imported PPTX text box whose bodyPr contains normAutofit with lnSpcReduction=20000, edit its text, then Save Copy. The preservation writer removed the original autofit node and recreated it with lnSpcReduction=0.
INKBUG-0001.expected: Text-only rewrite preserves the source lnSpcReduction value unless that formatting is explicitly changed.
INKBUG-0001.user_impact: Vertical line spacing can change after save/reopen, altering wrapping or clipping.
INKBUG-0001.data_integrity_impact: PPTX remains structurally valid but source formatting metadata is mutated.
INKBUG-0001.root_cause: apps/presentations/io/pptx-preservation-writer.js:setBodyPr discarded the pre-existing normAutofit lnSpcReduction before rebuilding bodyPr.
